prior: W-NCI10 original future-first-use valid negative: learned gate 72/192 vs coded72/192 (no gain); development-like 48/48 learned vs coded24/48 but reversed exposure 0 and uniform exposure 0 learned vs coded24/48. Baseline immutable; do not replay old heldout.
hypothesis: Selecting a 5-parameter native Go merge controller by actual downstream DEVELOPMENT future question-answering utility, not target-edge membership proxy classification, may yield robust delayed multi-chain recall under novel exposure/cross-branch distractors at the existing seven-chunk physical ceiling.
method: Nine prespecified diverse linear weight vectors x2 threshold choices (18 bounded hypotheses) fit/score on 8 train-only seeds32400..32407×4 families×2 future questions. Select four finalists using train query accuracy and operation cost, then one model by independent development validation32432..32439×4×2; freeze model+threshold before novel sealed first-use 32640..32663×4×2. Future queries used only for DEVELOPMENT score; real policy observes only public edge, exposure, timestamp and current memory. Existing 65-weight native lexical admission, 4-weight graph retention, 6-weight learned edge join, fixed two-link memory chunk representation, exact adjacency and coded span-aware retrieval remain pinned.
heldout: 24 unique seeds32640..32663 across four NCI10 fork/incoming graph exposure families; 96 states, 192 questions. Same grammar family as original NCI10 (replication with utility fit, not new grammar generalization).
criteria: R2_LEARNED_QUERY_UTILITY_TRANSFER iff learned>=.70 and improves coded original by >=.10 absolute with no novel family >.10 worse than coded. R2_PARTIAL_QUERY_UTILITY_GAIN if improvement >=.05. Else R2_NO_QUERY_UTILITY_TRANSFER, invalid full oracle overrides. Preserve negative even on low scores.
comparators: Original W NCI09 first-compatible coded chunking re-expressed in the SAME eight-byte packed native chunk structure as learned control (7 live entries and same span-aware reader); frozen 4-weight graph scorer and deterministic overflow rules unchanged. Separately score original NCI07 7 uncompressed edges and an unconstrained exact 12-link oracle. Both PRIMARY learned/coded arms have equal packed resident bytes per chunk and capacity; scratch heap allocations and inference compute may differ, so no total allocated-byte/FLOP matching claim. Report join candidate, gate logits, original wall time and raw record size.
controls: First-use source identity and hash frozen before execution

Full Go test/build, original archive before rubric, independent raw row-only reaggregation
